source: User-provided 4x4 Bella Companion Sprite Overview plus generated transparent keyframe redraw
extraction: Each visual state was cropped into its own transparent 256x256 PNG, preserving aspect ratio and centering on a transparent canvas.
animationMethod: 8-frame transparent APNG micro-motion generated from each of the 16 source keyframes
notes: All 16 source keyframes are retained unchanged under keyframes/.
The 16 gallery states each have an 8-frame RGBA APNG; 10 of these are mapped to the shared AgentSam runtime states.
Motion is whole-character micro-motion; no articulated tail, paw or facial rig is claimed.
